start: Watch app notifications allowed; a workout open on the phone

steps.action: Log a set on the phone
user_sees: The watch face shows "Rest 1:23" counting down
Card "Rest" with "Next: Set 3 of 5 · Bench Press" and buttons Done, +15 s, Skip
must_not: The countdown counting up
A buzz when the rest starts

steps.action: Tap +15 s
user_sees: The countdown 15 seconds longer within a few seconds
must_not: The phone's rest and the watch's different

steps.action: Tap Skip
user_sees: The card goes; the phone's rest ends
must_not: A "Rest is over" buzz after Skip

start: A rest running; the card shows Done

steps.action: Tap Done on the card
user_sees: The phone ticks the set the rest leads to; the next rest or set arrives
must_not: The card's Done ticking a different set

steps.action: Tap the card itself
user_sees: The watch app opens on the rest timer
must_not: Nothing opens

start: A rest running; the phone is out of range

steps.action: Tap +15 s
user_sees: "Phone not reachable"
must_not: The countdown changed on the watch only, without a word

steps.action: Tap Done when the phone cannot read the set
user_sees: "Not saved. Log this set on your phone"
must_not: The member left believing the set was saved

start: A rest running with its card

steps.action: Let the rest end
user_sees: The countdown card goes; "Rest is over" comes
must_not: The countdown card left on the watch face

steps.action: Start a rest, then discard the workout on the phone
user_sees: The card and its alarm go
must_not: A buzz after the workout was discarded

user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

start: Watch app notifications allowed; a workout open on the phone; set-up: longest name or text

must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the saved data saved with its text cut without a word to the user
